target_customer: Food wholesalers and distributors, starting with fish wholesalers, that take orders by WhatsApp, SMS, email and phone
problem: Wholesale order entry is manual and repetitive, with orders arriving across many channels and keyed into legacy ERPs.
business_model: B2B SaaS ERP with AI agents, with on-site onboarding
product_category: Vertical AI ERP for food distribution

founders.name: Mariem Ould Ismail
education: École Polytechnique, master's in applied mathematics
founders.background_notes: Her father is a fish wholesaler per the YC page.

founders.name: Moncef Djafri
founders.background_notes: Started coding at 13 per the YC page.

competitors.name: Choco (OrderAgent)
competitors.what: AI order processing from voicemail, WhatsApp and email into the ERP, with an Autopilot mode

technical_complexity.rationale: Multichannel order parsing with LLMs is mature, but reliable ERP integration and accuracy on messy orders take real engineering.

defensibility.rationale: An ERP that holds customer data and workflows creates lock in, but order capture alone can be copied by funded rivals.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Choco already sold AI order entry when Stockline started. No source shows it copying or buying Stockline.

market_need_then: Food distribution relies on manual order entry from chat and phone, and a funded vendor already sold AI order capture in 2025.

identity.voice_and_tone: Positions itself as an AI partner, tagline Always ahead

brand_strength.rationale: No press about the brand was found, and the name is a generic compound.

outcome_analysis: Stockline is active and early. One founder grew up in the fish wholesale business, which gives domain insight, but a funded competitor already sold AI order entry and no verified funding or customers are public.
notes: Aggregators list about $500K pre-seed from 2025-09 with conflicting investors (Better Angle vs Entrepreneur First and LombardStreet Ventures), unverified, not recorded as rounds. The Anchr $5.8M seed in search results belongs to a different company. Outcome search found nothing about Stockline. Founder prior employers not found. The YC launch post says the team is in Paris while the directory says San Francisco.
